title: DWC_usb31 feature list + Unsupported Features/Usage Restrictions/Fixed-ECNs (verification-relevant errata)
summary: DWC_usb31 v2.10a Databook Chapter 1 'Product Overview' SS1.2 (line 1503-1998) is the authoritative full feature list, organized as: SS1.2.1 General Features (5 speed modes, streams 1-16 bursts, internal DMA, LPM in USB2 + U0-U3 for USB3.1, hardware-controlled LPM in USB2.0 host [host-only, autonomous LPM token on idle downstream port], dynamic FIFO alloc, non-power-of-2 FIFO sizes, descriptor caching, interrupt moderation); SS1.2.2 System Bus Interface (AHB/AXI, AXI3.0-compliant with AXI4 caveats [no write interleaving, no out-of-order addr/data phase], 64/128-bit data, 32/64-bit addr, independent endian per completer/requester and per descriptor-vs-data); SS1.2.3 USB3.1 Device Features (up to 16 bidirectional EPs, 10Gbps IN+OUT, UASP stream support, ADC3.0, Ethernet-over-USB packet gathering, MIPI Gigabit Debug support, EBC); SS1.2.4 USB3.1 xHCI Host Features (up to 127 devices, 8 interrupters, 15 USB2 ports + 4 ESS ports, xHCI1.2-compatible with named non-conformant optional caps, concurrent USB3.1/2.0/1.1 traffic giving 19.88Gbps net, DbC support, Event Ring Segment Table max 15 entries); SS1.2.5 DRD Features (ONLY 'Static Device operation' + 'Static Host operation' listed -- no dynamic role-swap/OTG negotiation claimed, consistent with OTG being explicitly unsupported); SS1.2.6 Power Optimization (3-tier: system/RTL/gate-level; Hibernation = PMUs ~5K gates on separate Vaux rail vs ~250K-gate Vcc controller in device mode; 'Hibernation feature is supported only in device, host, and DRD configurations' -- not Hub/ROUTERIF); SS1.2.7 Area Reduction; SS1.2.8 Performance; SS1.2.9 MIPS Reduction; SS1.2.10 Debug Features (CPU R/W to all internal RAMs via completer IF, 64-bit logic-analyzer trace port, loopback mode). Baseline gate counts (Table 1-4, line 2003): Device(4 EPs)~500K gates, Host(1 port)~1350K gates, DRD(1 port)~1550K gates. UNSUPPORTED/ERRATA (SS1.5-1.6, line 2035-2126) -- directly relevant to what a verification plan must NOT test as if functional: Unsupported Configurations = Multi-Port DRD, Single-Port RAM, Number-of-RAMs!=3, DWC_USB31_MDWIDTH=32, Native interface, AHB-as-requester (not recommended, doesn't meet USB3.1 perf), USB3.0-only mode, USB2.0-only mode, ESS-Root-count != ESS-Bus-Instance-count. Unsupported Features = 8/16-bit PIPE widths (only 32-bit supported), IC-USB, 3-pin/6-pin USB1.1 serial, I2C/CarKit, SSIC, OTG, ADP, Battery Charger, BIST-in-Host-Mode. Unsupported xHCI optional capabilities = Get Port Bandwidth Command (deprecated, do not use), I/O Virtualization, Message Interrupt, Extended Message Interrupt, Local Memory, Get/Set Extended Properties Commands, xHCI Audio Sideband. Usage Restrictions = ADC3.0 EA limited to 8-bit UTMI/ULPI only; host_u3_port_disable[n]>=host_num_u3_port implies no-PHY-attached assumption with a D3-entry-before-PHY-low-power caveat; do NOT enable both GUSB3PIECTL[U2P3ok] and LLUCTL[U2P3CPMok] together (P3/P3CPM in U2); GFLADJ frame-length-adjustment is deprecated in USB3.1 and must stay at default; enable AXI Strict Ordering to avoid HW/SW race hazard; 40MHz ref_clk is NOT supported. Known Issues (Ch1 SS1.6): HW compliance testing still in progress at Synopsys Lab (only entry in Databook itself; substantive known-issues live in Release Notes instead). Appendix H 'Fixed ECNs' (line 21654+, also replicated in the Programming Guide) tracks USB-IF/Intel spec ECNs per-layer with RTL-fixed-version or status: notable OUTSTANDING items -- ECN009 'efficient ISO/PING' (Protocol layer, status 'Not implemented': with >1 ISOC EP of differing service intervals, device must keep link in U0 for the largest-interval EP); 'US Port state m/c' erratum (Peripheral layer, 'Not implemented', workaround = 'enabling GCTL[16]'). Fixed-in-1.10a items: USB3.1 ECN CTLE (CP13-CP16 polynomial extension) and ECN HSEQ (Gen2 header sequence number range extended 0-7 to 0-15), both Link-layer.
